title: Review: Colombia's Caribbean coast, Pacific and Amazon
goal: Review the passive with ser, formal cause connectors, formal register, reported speech and aun cuando on the themes of this unit.
grammar: repaso integral de la diversidad pluriétnica, derechos colectivos y memoria histórica de Colombia

items: I can use the passive, cause connectors, formal register, reported speech and *aun cuando* about Colombia's regions.
I can tell Palenque, the Pacific coast, Law 70, the peace process and Chiribiquete apart.
I can read short Spanish texts about these regions and answer questions.
I can say who founded, built or recognised something with *ser* + past participle.
I can give a cause with *debido a* or *a raíz de* and a noun.
I can turn a request into a formal rule and report what a source said.
I can use *aun cuando* with the indicative for a fact and the subjunctive for a possibility.
